narr: Tropical Cyclone Debby tracking northward from the Carolinas across western Virginia produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of south central Virginia.
ev: Virginia Department of Transportation reported a road was closed due to standing water in both lanes.
Virginia Department of Transportation reported a road was closed due to flooding.
Virginia Department of Transportation reported that a portion of Finneywood Road was closed due to flooding.

Virginia Department of Transportation reported a road was closed due to flooding near the intersection of Abilene Road and Farmville Road.

Low water crossing was impassable on Moore Road near Spring Creek.
